questions.question: What is the subject of chapter 30?
What did God say about a vow a man makes to the LORD?
options: He may break it if a priest grants release
A vow may be undone by paying a small fine
Only vows made at the temple are binding
He must not break his word; he must keep it
questions.answer: He must not break his word; he must keep it
